_comment: Copy this to .config/debugConfig.json (that folder is gitignored) to give the Layer 1 View cold-start defaults. Every field is optional. Precedence, highest first: a ?dir=/?repo= link, then ~/.jfred-layer1-settings.json, then this file. `npm run visual` reads dir/repo from here too, so the harness and the browser open the same project.
jsonl: /absolute/path/to/.claude/projects/<the project folder path, every non-alphanumeric character replaced by a hyphen>
